headline: Eurozone and EU inflation rose in October to 4%, highest since 2023
summary: Annual inflation in the euro area and the EU rose to 4% in October, the highest since 2023. Inflation fell in nine member states, held steady in two and rose in sixteen.
why: Eurostat compiles the euro area's harmonised inflation data, which the European Central Bank weighs when setting interest rates for the 20 euro-area countries.
why_moved: Inflation at a two-and-a-half-year high raises the likelihood of tighter monetary policy from the European Central Bank, which tends to lift euro-area bond yields.
original_headline: Inflación en la eurozona y en la UE repuntó en octubre al 4%, en máximos desde 2023
